generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Eligible tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity (A X N X 2.5-B)Where,A- Maximum value of Labor Supply Works executed in any one year during the last five yearsUpdated to 2026-27 price level taking in to account the completed as well as works in progressN -Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited B Value at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next years Period of completion of works for which tenders are invited.
The intending bidder should furnish the copy of the registration certificate issued by KPWD IV and above for Civil contractor
The intending bidder should furnish the profit and loss statements and balance sheets of any preceding 5 years
The bidder should furnish Annual turn over certificate indicating turnover of past five years with compulsory UDIN Number.
Tenderer should furnish a copy of the Income Tax Return for the preceding five financial year (2021-22 to 2025-26)

Employees Provident Fund Registration Certificate, ( For all indents above ) and if the bidder has less than 20 labours he has to submit self-certified labour details failing which which their tenders will be disqualified.
The Tenderer should furnish a valid copy of GST Registration Certificate
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Other documents as per notification and bid document

itemList.itemCode: P.no.9, It no.2.5 (ii),a, PWD SR 2023-24 Vol-2
itemList.description: Clearing and grubbing road land including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer. In area of light jungle etc,. complete with all lead and lifts as per Specification and work as directed by Engineer in Charge. ---- Complete work with all lead and lift and as per the specification and as per instructions of Engineer Incharge of work

Cutting and removing  jauliflora bushes upto 1.50 m  girth excluding removal of  stumps and  including burning  or  disposing off  the materials  as directed with all other ancillary  operations complete. etc,. complete with all lead and lifts as per Specification and work as directed by Engineer in Charge. ---- Complete work with all lead and lift and as per the specification and as per instructions of Engineer Incharge of work
